title: Event
description: FROZEN at 0:15. The single normalized shape every ingestor writes and every reader (timeline, alerts, brief) renders. Do not add/rename/remove fields without an orchestrator broadcast.

id.description: Stable dedupe key. Convention: '<source>-<naturalkey>'. Re-ingesting the same real-world event MUST produce the same id (Neo4j MERGE key).

time.description: ISO8601 WITH offset, Asia/Tokyo (+09:00). Never naive.

lat.description: null = area-wide event with no single point

title.description: English one-liner for the timeline row.

titleJa.description: Japanese one-liner. null if source had no JP text.

affects.description: Typed refs. Exactly 'line:<lineId>' (lineId from contracts/lines.csv) or 'ward:<WardName>' (ward name from contracts/wards.csv). Empty array allowed.

maxScale.description: quake only: JMA shindo *10 (e.g. 45 = shindo 4.5). P2PQuake native.
